verdict.rationale: Cloudflare claims 'built-in observability' for Workers, and its MCP fleet exposes separate Workers Builds, Observability, and Logpush servers. That suggests build and runtime telemetry are reachable, and event subscriptions can emit 'Worker build completing' events. Nothing in the evidence shows build, deploy, and runtime logs together in one unified view; they appear spread across separate surfaces. Missing for 10: evidence of a single unified log view, documented build-log and deploy-log viewing, detail on what runtime logs include (tail/search/retention), and independent hands-on corroboration.
